rows.reasoning: Wirch voted Nay on AB 103, whose operative section bars staff from using a name or pronouns not aligned with biological sex "without written authorization from the pupil’s parent or legal guardian" — the rung "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns." Opposing that rung does not show which of the remaining rungs (secrecy, forbidding notification rules, notice on request, or mandatory notification) he holds, and his Nays on the multi-subject parents' bills of rights (AB 963, AB 510) prove nothing about the names-and-pronouns clause.
